name: 半开放分层易清洗猫砂盆款
description: 半开放大空间分层猫砂盆，隐私围挡、上下分层易清洗、省砂防外溅

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 奶油黄纯色底与蜜桃橙纵向渐变交替，樱花粉圆角大卡承载内容区
styleLock.lightingSystem: 明亮柔和的暖调漫射光，左上或右上主光，软阴影，无硬投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 哑光摄影无缝背景与暖木色地板、圆形展示台面
styleLock.typography: 圆润可爱 sans-serif，白色描边泡泡字大标题，配小号字距加宽英文副题
styleLock.iconSystem: 樱粉圆形徽章配浅色线性小图标，圆角药丸形标签，NO./DETAILS 序号标签
styleLock.presentationRules: 产品始终为低矮半 enclosed 盆体，稳定居中或落于台面，比例一致
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet cream pet-commerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of cream-yellow base #FFF4DC, peach gradient accent #FFB27A, sakura-pink panel #FBD3C4 and coral-orange highlight #F2705B; warm tone; rounded playful sans-serif typography, white-outlined bubble headline style; soft rounded-corner card panels, pill badge shapes, thin dashed warm dividers; bright diffused warm lighting, soft shadows, clean gentle gradient backdrops; product shown as a low semi-enclosed litter basin with stable scale and centered stability; clean breathing margins around every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏一秒传达大空间低门槛出入的核心卖点，承接点击
shots.camera: 略低正面 3/4 机位，产品立于右下圆形台面，全景
shots.lighting: 左上暖调漫射主光，软阴影，渐变背景通透
shots.background: 蜜桃橙到奶油黄纵向渐变 #FFB27A→#FFF4DC，右侧白色竖条纹装饰板
shots.props: 圆形展示台面、白色竖条纹装饰板
shots.textZone: 左半版文案槽：顶部药丸品类标签、两行白描边泡泡大标题「{callout_1}」、小号字距加宽英文副题与短正文块「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce detail-page opening benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed at a slightly low front 3/4 angle, {product} standing on a round pedestal filling the lower-right half of the frame, a white fluted decorative panel column along the right edge, and the left half carrying the copy block. Bright diffused warm key light from upper-left, soft shadows, matte seamless backdrop flowing from peach #FFB27A at the top to cream #FFF4DC at the bottom. {product} occupies 50-60% of frame. Text zone: top-left pill-shaped category tag, below it two lines of large white-outlined bubble headline 「{callout_1}」 in coral #F2705B, a small letter-spaced English sub-caption, and a short body block 「{selling_point_1}」; all copy short and readable. 2K detail-page quality. Negative: no real brand names, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no dense paragraphs, no hands, no cut-off product, no cluttered props.

shots.intent: 用 2x2 圆形徽章网格快速铺开四大卖点，建立整体利益认知
shots.camera: 正视平面图形版式，徽章 2x2 对称网格，俯视平铺感
shots.lighting: 整版均匀柔和暖光，无方向性硬影
shots.background: 奶油黄 #FFF4DC 纯色，底部浅粉圆角长条分隔
shots.props: 樱粉圆形徽章 ×4（浅色叶片图标）
shots.textZone: 信息图版式：每枚徽章下方珊瑚橙短标签「{selling_point_1}」至「{selling_point_4}」与小号英文副题；底部居中版块标题「{callout_2}」与英文副题
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce infographic benefit grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Flat symmetrical graphic panel, straight-on view like a 90-degree overhead flat-lay, four circular sakura-pink badges arranged in a 2x2 grid filling the panel with about 12% outer margins, each badge holding a light leaf line-icon in peach #FFB27A. Even soft warm lighting across the panel, cream-yellow background #FFF4DC, a soft pink rounded divider bar near the bottom. Graphic elements occupy 40-50%. Text zone: four short labels 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」「{selling_point_4}」 in coral #F2705B under each badge with tiny letter-spaced English sub-captions, plus a bottom centered section title 「{callout_2}」 with a small English sub-line. 2K quality. Negative: no real brand names, no watermark, no QR code, no fake certifications, no dense body text, no gradient banding, no inconsistent icon styles.

shots.intent: 用信息表与双尺寸图一次消除规格与尺寸疑虑
shots.camera: 正视，产品两个尺寸并排正视示意，配尺寸标注线
shots.lighting: 均匀平光，保证表格与标注清晰可读
shots.background: 奶油黄 #FFF4DC，暖色虚线分隔的产品信息表
shots.textZone: 规格卡版式：上部虚线信息表（名称/适用/产地短行标签）；下部两个尺寸图各配珊瑚橙尺寸标注与「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」规格标签，单位清晰
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce size spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Clean straight-on front view, two dimension diagrams side by side filling the lower two-thirds and showing {product} in two sizes with thin coral #F2705B dimension arrows, above them a spec table separated by warm dashed dividers. Even flat readable lighting, cream-yellow background #FFF4DC. Product diagrams occupy 60-70%. Text zone: spec rows with a product-name row, a suitability row and an origin row as short labels, and dimension labels 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 for the two sizes with clear units. 2K quality. Negative: no real brand names, no invented certifications, no dense body text, no watermark, no unreadable tiny text, no cut-off dimension lines.

shots.intent: 猫视角低机位家居场景，让买家代入宠物使用的安心与隐私
shots.camera: 贴近地面的低机位平视（猫视角），产品置于明亮家居角落
shots.lighting: 左侧自然窗光 5500K，柔和长影，暖调
shots.background: 奶油色室内墙角 #FFF4DC，暖木色地板，樱花粉地垫 #FBD3C4
shots.textZone: 纯摄影场景，仅顶部居中珊瑚橙短标题「{callout_4}」与小号英文副题
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Lifestyle scene of {product} placed in a cozy bright home toilet corner. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed from a low eye-level camera close to the floor, as if seen from a cat's perspective, the semi-enclosed body of {product} turned toward the wall corner and taking up about 40-50% of the frame to suggest privacy and gentle airflow. Soft natural window light from the left at 5500K, gentle shadows on a warm wood-look floor, cream interior walls #FFF4DC and a sakura-pink rug #FBD3C4. Text zone: top centered headline 「{callout_4}」 in coral #F2705B with a small English sub-line. 2K quality. Negative: no distorted animal anatomy, no hands covering the product, no real brand names, no watermark, no extra text, no cluttered background, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 以痛点句与 NO.1-3 编号卡放大猫咪拒绝如厕的三大原因，制造问题张力

shots.lighting: 均匀柔和暖光，版面干净可读
shots.background: 奶油黄 #FFF4DC 过渡到樱花粉面板 #FBD3C4 的分区底
shots.props: NO.1/NO.2/NO.3 白色泡泡序号标签
shots.textZone: 编号卡信息版式：顶部痛点句「{callout_5}」；三张卡内短句「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce pain-point infographic about litter-box avoidance. {product_identity_lock}. Slightly elevated graphic layout on a sakura-pink panel #FBD3C4: a top strip with a short pain headline above a small clean render of {product} as the resolution, then three rounded cream cards stacked vertically and filling the lower half with about 12% outer margins, each tagged with a white bubble number NO.1, NO.2, NO.3. Soft even warm lighting, warm background blending cream #FFF4DC into peach panels. {product} occupies 40-50%. Text zone: top pain headline 「{callout_5}」 in coral #F2705B, card labels 「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」 kept to short phrases. 2K quality. Negative: no fabricated statistics, no real brand names, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logos, no distorted text, no cluttered layout.

shots.intent: 高角度拆解视图证明上下分层的结构机制，支撑易清洗卖点
shots.camera: 高角度 45° 俯视，上盆与下座垂直分离的爆炸拆解视图
shots.lighting: 顶光均匀，柔和接触阴影，部件不悬空
shots.background: 奶油黄 #FFF4DC，两块樱花粉圆角标注卡 #FBD3C4
shots.props: 上/下层樱花粉圆角标注卡
shots.textZone: 拆解图两侧通用标签「上层」「下层」与珊瑚橙副句「{callout_9}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce structural infographic of {product} showing its layered design. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree overhead angle, upper tray and lower base of {product} shown separated in a clean exploded view that fills 65-75% of the frame, aligned vertically with breathing space between layers. Bright even studio light from above, soft contact shadows under both sections, cream-yellow background #FFF4DC with two rounded sakura-pink label panels #FBD3C4 beside the sections. Text zone: short generic labels 「上层」 and 「下层」 near the two sections and a sub-line 「{callout_9}」 in coral #F2705B. 2K quality. Negative: no floating products without contact shadow, no duplicated parts, no real brand names, no dense body text, no watermark, no warped edges.

shots.intent: 侧视使用动作演示拆开倒砂与清洗的轻松，落实打理成本诉求
shots.camera: 腰高 90° 正侧机位，双手抬起上盆倾倒旧砂，动作清晰
shots.lighting: 右侧暖调漫射光，柔和阴影
shots.background: 奶油色室内 #FFF4DC，蜜桃橙 #FFB27A 点缀墙
shots.textZone: 纯摄影动作场景，仅底部居中珊瑚橙短句「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Lifestyle usage scene of {product} being cleaned. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at waist height, one pair of natural hands lifting the upper section of {product} to pour used litter into a simple bag, the action clearly readable and the product-action group filling 50-60% of the frame. Bright diffused warm lighting from the right, soft shadows, cream interior background #FFF4DC with a peach #FFB27A accent wall. Text zone: bottom centered short headline 「{callout_2}」 in coral #F2705B. 2K quality. Negative: no deformed hands or fused fingers, no hands covering the product label, no real brand names, no dense body text, no watermark, no messy spilled litter chaos, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 微距特写包围式围栏，证明加高围挡与防外溅的工艺可信度
shots.camera: 微距特写，略高 45° 机位，浅景深，前景围栏锐利
shots.lighting: 左侧掠射侧光揭示壁厚与表面质感，高光可控
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the enclosed fence rim of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed from a slightly high 45-degree angle with shallow depth of field, foreground rim sharp, raking side light from the left revealing surface texture and wall thickness. Cream-yellow background #FFF4DC softly blurred, warm tone. Detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margins, the macro detail itself is the whole point of the shot. 2K quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated textures, no real brand names, no dense body text, no watermark, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 以两张细节卡收口展示做工与品质，降低最后决策疑虑
shots.camera: 正视图形版式，两张圆角细节卡纵向堆叠，各含产品工艺特写与说明区
shots.lighting: 均匀高调暖光，干净通透
shots.background: 奶油黄 #FFF4DC，卡片面 #FBD3C4，一张卡以蜜桃橙圆 #FFB27A 点缀、另一张镜像
shots.textZone: 双细节卡版式：顶部居中版块标题「{callout_3}」；卡内通用标签「DETAILS 1」「DETAILS 2」与短信任标签「{selling_point_5}」「{selling_point_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce trust screen with two detail cards for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Two rounded rectangular cards stacked vertically and filling the frame with about 15% outer margins, each pairing a close-up crop of a craftsmanship detail of {product} with a clean caption area; the upper card accented by a peach circle #FFB27A on the right, the lower mirrored with the circle on the left. Even high-key warm lighting, cream-yellow background #FFF4DC, card fills in soft peach #FBD3C4. Detail crops occupy 50-60% overall. Text zone: top centered section title 「{callout_3}」 in coral #F2705B, card tags 「DETAILS 1」 and 「DETAILS 2」, and short trust labels 「{selling_point_5}」 「{selling_point_6}」. 2K quality. Negative: do not invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fake logos, no QR code, no watermark, no real brand names, no dense body text, no distorted crops.

provenance.notes: 源夹名为泛称「宠物用品 (2)」，实拍内容为分层猫砂盆（半开放、上下分层、包围围栏），按图判定 L2=清洁；库内已有 10 款模版中无猫砂盆，定位不重合。已剥离店铺二维码与「加入会员」水印、原品牌字样与原版中文文案（80% 数据句等改为 selling_point/callout 占位符，由使用者填入真实内容）、泡泡字专属字形。假设：多数切片实拍区为纯色底面板，实拍构图按版式与文案语义推断；痛点数据句一律以占位符表达，生成时须由使用者提供真实数据。
